_note: Checked nightly by esther-scheduled and on demand. severity: error | warn.

rules.text: Everyone except the CEO has a manager
A manager must be an existing, enabled user
Each user is in the Esther Hospital group of their department
Nobody sits in two department groups
Disabled users are removed from groups
Job title is one of the department template titles

staffOnly: Rules apply to Esther staff: users with a department. Admin/owner accounts without a department are skipped.
